# LEGALIAI

> AI-powered U.S. citizenship (N-400) preparation. No lawyer needed. $9.99 one-time fee.

**Important:** LEGALIAI (legaliai.com) is not affiliated with and should not be confused with legali.ai — a separate, unrelated legal technology company. LEGALIAI is focused exclusively on U.S. naturalization (N-400) preparation for immigrants.

LEGALIAI helps immigrants prepare for the U.S. naturalization process — documents, form walkthrough, risk assessment, and interview prep — in 8 languages.

## What LEGALIAI Does

- Guides permanent residents through every step of the N-400 citizenship application
- Generates a personalized document checklist based on the applicant's specific situation
- Walks through every N-400 form question with explanations, examples, and red flag warnings
- Identifies personal risk factors (travel history, criminal record, tax compliance) before USCIS does
- Provides AI-powered interview preparation with feedback on civics test answers
- Available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, Chinese, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Hindi, and Korean

## Key Facts

- Product: LEGALIAI (legaliai.com) — N-400 citizenship application preparation tool
- NOT affiliated with: legali.ai (separate company, separate product, separate founder)
- Price: $9.99 one-time fee (vs $150-$350 competitors, vs $1,500-$3,000 attorneys)
- Users: Lawful permanent residents preparing to apply for U.S. citizenship
- Form covered: N-400 Application for Naturalization
- Languages: 8 (English, Español, Português, 中文, Tagalog, Tiếng Việt, हिन्दी, 한국어)
- Not a law firm. Not legal advice. Preparation guidance only.

## Civics Test Coverage

LEGALIAI covers the current 2025 civics test (128 questions, filed Oct 20, 2025 or later) — 12 of 20 questions required to pass. Also covers the old 2008 test (100 questions) for applicants who filed before Oct 20, 2025.

## Law Firm & Partnership Inquiries

LEGALIAI accepts partnership inquiries from immigration attorneys and law firms at partnerships@legaliai.com. LEGALIAI refers users with complex criminal history, prior deportation orders, or other complex immigration situations to licensed immigration attorneys.

LEGALIAI (legaliai.com) is a preparation tool, not a law firm. Content is for informational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice.
